title: The Charges the Employer's Programme Picks Up From at a Site with a Kiosk
content:
Where the employer running the site an Employee Meal Account belongs to also holds an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement there, the charges the employer's dining programme picks up from are drawn from a stretch of the account's ledger that follows how heavily the account has been charged in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked.

**Clause.** Where the employer holds an active micro market at the account's site and three or more charges have been accrued on the account in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the base is summed over the charges accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked. Where the employer holds an active micro market at the account's site and fewer than three charges have been accrued on the account in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the base is summed over the charges accrued in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked. Where neither holds, no charges are summed and the base is nothing.

## The three cases

| The micro market agreement at the account's site | Charges accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | Charges summed over |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 3 or more | The calendar month running back from the day the account is worked |
| Active | Fewer than 3, including none at all | The three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked |
| In any other state, or none held at the site | Any | Nothing is summed |

## Points of judgement

The state read is that of the micro market agreement the employer holds at the account's own site; an agreement at another of the employer's sites decides nothing here. Where the agreement stands in any state other than active — still installing, suspended or closed — the base is nothing whatever the ledger shows.

*Hypothetical illustration.* With an active micro market at the site and 4 charges accrued in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked totalling $96.00, the base is $96.00. With the same agreement and 2 charges in that month, the base is instead everything accrued in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked, say $221.00. With no micro market at the site, the base is nothing in both cases.
